name: Unknown Base MEV bot unvalidated uniswapV3SwapCallback
summary: The bot's uniswapV3SwapCallback took the token from msg.sender.token0() and paid the owed amount by transferFrom from a payer named in the callback data, without checking that the caller was a genuine pool. The attacker's fake pool called it 219 times naming operator EOA 0xc0ffee47, which had approved the bot, and pulled its WETH; copycats then took more WETH and LINK.
notes: Direct, non-upgradeable bot runtime whose callback lacked caller validation since deployment; the operator's token approvals only set exposure.

Campaign and loss from every WETH, LINK and other token outflow of the approving operator EOAs 0xc0ffee47 and 0xbf0e3642 since the bot's deployment: all earlier outflows went to genuine pools or the operators' own trades; copycats 0x083a5afd, 0x83906ebf and 0x6d10b7d5 followed the anchor within hours.
